agentProfileHelp: Default agent profile for tasks in this workflow. When set, the agent selector is locked in the task creation dialog.
allowManualMoveHelp: Allow dragging tasks into this step on the board.
autoArchiveHelp: Automatically archive tasks after they have been in this step for a set number of hours. Useful for the last step of a workflow (e.g., Done) to keep the board clean.
autoStartAgentHelp: Automatically start the agent when a task enters this step.
childrenCompletedHelp: Use this on a parent task step. When every active direct child task is COMPLETED, FAILED, or CANCELLED, Kandev runs this transition once. Archived and ephemeral child tasks are ignored. Grandchildren do not count here, and nothing runs if the parent has no child tasks.
childrenCompletedHelpAria: How child task completion transitions work
configureOriginalSessionOptionsDescripti: Change the existing conversation tab only when its initial agent family matches a rule.
confirmWorkflowCycleDescription: Review the repeated agent run before continuing.
customTemplateDescription: Create your own agentic workflow from scratch.
deleteStepAffectsTasks_one: Deleting {{stepName}} will also affect its {{count}} task.
deleteStepAffectsTasks_other: Deleting {{stepName}} will also affect its {{count}} tasks.
deleteStepNoTasks: This will permanently delete the {{stepName}} workflow step.
deleteStepWithMigration_one: {{stepName}} has {{count}} task. Choose where to migrate them, or delete the step and its tasks.
deleteStepWithMigration_other: {{stepName}} has {{count}} tasks. Choose where to migrate them, or delete the step and its tasks.
deleteWorkflowNoTasks: This will permanently delete the workflow and all its steps.
deleteWorkflowWithTasks_one: This workflow has {{count}} task. Choose where to migrate them, or delete the workflow and archive the tasks.
deleteWorkflowWithTasks_other: This workflow has {{count}} tasks. Choose where to migrate them, or delete the workflow and archive the tasks.
disablePlanModeOnCompleteHelp: Turn off plan mode after the agent finishes a turn, even when the task remains in this step.
disablePlanModeOnExitHelp: Keep plan mode on for every turn in this step, then turn it off only when the task moves to another step.
failedToCheckWorkflowStepTasks: Failed to check workflow step tasks
failedToLoadSyncConfig: Failed to load workflow sync config: {{error}}
githubSyncDescription: Automatically sync workflow definitions from a GitHub repository into this workspace.
name: Name
notARecognizedGitHubLink: Not a recognized GitHub repository link.
notSyncedYet: not synced yet — use Sync now
onExitHelp: Runs when leaving this step (before entering the next step).
onTurnCompleteHelp: Runs after the agent finishes a turn. Use to auto-advance tasks through the pipeline.
onTurnStartHelp: Runs when a user sends a message. Use for review cycles (e.g., move back to In Progress on feedback).
overrideAgentProfileHelp: Override the agent profile for this step. A different profile creates a new session with fresh context when entering this step.
overrideOriginalSessionOptionsHelp: Keep the original conversation tab while changing its session settings for this step. For example, start with model 5.6 Sol and switch to 5.6 Luna for implementation work.
pasteGitHubLinkHint: Paste a GitHub link — /tree/… links carry the branch and directory too.
planModeHelp: Agent proposes a plan instead of making changes directly.
pollDisabledHint: Syncs only run when you press Sync now.
pollEnabledHint: Checks the repository on this interval (minimum 60s).
promptSourceStepPrompt: Re-entering "{{stepName}}" sends its step prompt instead of the task description.
promptSourceStepPromptWithTaskDescriptio: Re-entering "{{stepName}}" sends its rendered step prompt including the task description.
promptSourceTaskDescription: "{{stepName}}" has no step prompt, so re-entering it sends the task description.
pullFromHelp: Optional feeder step to pull queued work from when this step has capacity.
removeConditionalSessionConfigBeforeProf: Remove the conditional session configuration before choosing a fixed agent profile for this step.
removeSyncConfirm: Remove workflow sync configuration? This will not delete already-synced workflows.
resetAgentContextHelp: Restart the agent with a fresh conversation context when entering this step. Useful for review steps that need an unbiased perspective.
resetAgentContextHelpWithProfile: Not needed — switching agent profiles already creates a new session with fresh context.
retryPartialSaveBeforeLeaving: Retry the partial workflow save before leaving
runCompletionActionsWhenTurnCancelled: Run completion actions when a turn is cancelled
runCompletionActionsWhenTurnCancelledHel: Applies only when a user explicitly cancels a turn. The destination step’s on-enter actions may immediately start another agent turn.
sessionConfigCarryForwardWarning: Earlier workflow settings may carry into this step because the original conversation tab is reused.
sessionConfigCarryForwardWarningMessage: Settings changed in {{stepName}} may carry into this step for {{agentName}}. Choose keep, restore original, or set new values.
sessionConfigEmptyRules: Add a condition to choose which initial agent receives settings.
sessionConfigFixedProfileWarning: Remove the fixed profile override before configuring the original session. The two behaviors are mutually exclusive.
sessionConfigModelOptionsUnavailable: Model options are unavailable for this agent. Refresh agent capabilities before saving this condition.
sessionConfigRulesHelp: Rules apply to the task's first agent session. They never create or switch conversation tabs.
showInCommandPanelHelp: Show tasks in this step when opening the command panel (Cmd+K). Useful for hiding backlog or done steps from quick access.
startStepHelp: New tasks start in this step. Only one step per workflow can be the start step.
stepIsPartOfReplayCycle: {{stepName}} is part of a replay cycle
stepPromptHelp: Custom instructions for the agent on this step. Use {{taskPrompt}} to include the task description.
stepPromptPlaceholderTaskPrompt: The original task description provided by the user
stepPromptUsageHint: Type {{open}} for placeholders ({{taskPrompt}} inserts the task description) or @ to reference a saved prompt by name — its content is attached as hidden context, and editing the saved prompt updates every step that references it. Note: {{taskPrompt}} only expands in the step prompt itself, not inside a referenced saved prompt.
syncDirectoryHelp: The directory should contain workflow export files (.yml/.yaml/.json) in the kandev_workflow format — the same format produced by workflow export.
syncedBadgeTooltip: Read-only - managed by workflow sync from {{source}}. Edit or remove it in the synced repository.
syncedReadOnlyReason: Managed by workflow sync — edit or remove it in the synced repository
syncRemoved: Workflow sync removed — synced workflows are editable again
unsavedStepChangesDiscarded: Unsaved step changes will be discarded.
unsavedWorkflowChangesDiscarded: Unsaved workflow changes will be discarded.
waitForAgentCompletionSignalHelp: Only auto-advance once the agent calls {{tool}}. Otherwise turn-end is treated as completion.
waitingForRetry: Waiting for the failed change to be retried.
wipLimitHelp: Maximum admitted (active) tasks in this step. Overflow stays visible in a queue. Use 0 for unlimited.
wipLimitsNote: WIP limits active work, not visibility. Overflow remains on the board until capacity opens; if a selected feeder is also full, new task creation is rejected.
workflowCycleBlockedDescription: Change the workflow steps to remove the automatic cycle before continuing.
workflowCycleBlockingBody: This path re-enters "{{stepName}}" and can start the agent again without another user action.
workflowCycleWarningBody: This path can re-enter "{{stepName}}" and start the agent again after a user action.
workflowsSectionDescription: Create autonomous pipelines with automated transitions or manual workflows where you move tasks yourself
